title: File exceeds 1000 lines (2159 lines)
detail: File is 2159 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Broad exception caught (bare `except Exception`) at 10 sites (L179,L412,L885,L1097,L1120,L1128)
detail: `except Exception` catches all exceptions without re-raising, swallowing unexpected errors silently. This hides failures and makes the caller unable to distinguish success from silent failure. Suggested fix: catch only the exception types the callee can raise, or use `excutils.save_and_reraise_exception()` for cleanup handlers.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 4 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L92,L99,L852,L1571)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.

title: Exception context suppressed: 1 `raise` statements without `from` (L1695)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.
